Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire; move+fire simultaneously works. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse) that damages self; warping does not outrun the fuse. Q/Space appear to do nothing. Empty heart outlines plus a blood-splatter visual = death.

WARP/HATCH MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warping needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame; holding into the frame ~1.0-1.2s usually works, but standing ON the frame can block it (back off ~0.15, re-center, retry; multiple attempts normal). Diagonal walks into a frame from the top row have also triggered warps. Rocks directly below a hatch block vertical approach; route along the top row and walk sideways into the frame. Doorways may need y-alignment: the start room's right-wall ornate doorway has been entered by diagonal up-right then a straight push, and once by a diagonal down-right push; whether diagonal input is strictly required or only y-alignment matters is unresolved (guess: y-alignment).

TECH X: entering the two-poop room auto-grants Tech X ('Laser ring Tears'); re-confirmed on multiple visits. Firing produces a red squiggly laser ring lingering ~1s at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column. Rocks block lasers and are NOT destroyed by them. The red ring is my own attack, not a lock marker/telegraph (uncertain). Lasers killed a white-faced chaser at range, but chasers close fast and can hit first; fight only at range with correct row/column aim.

ROUTE/MAP (transitions observed):
- Start/mural room (floor start, murals): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.50 <-> torch room; right-wall ornate door (y~0.40-0.55, x~0.78-0.82) <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field (above start room): bottom hatch ~x0.50 <-> start room; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; gold/ornate door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48. Hazards: fast white-faced chasers clustering near hatches (they transform into winged flying forms and into spiked-ring enemies), green glowing blobs that expand into large damaging bursts, small spiky pellets (guess: turret), spiked wheels, blue-tear shooters, and a spiked black rock ring with a gray enemy at room center. Severe heart drainer; do not loiter.
- Torch room (below start room): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> start room; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Center column rock-choked; safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height and right lane x~0.63 traversable. Center gray chest sealed by indestructible rocks — ABANDON. Corner torches (roughly x0.25/0.75, y0.25/0.77) damage on touch. Small dark specks near left wall (~0.30,0.43) treated as minor hazards.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17 (approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks). Tech X auto-grants on entry. Poop piles harmless and regenerate. A center rock vanished on one later visit (cause unknown; NOT attributable to lasers).
- TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, are inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall (guess: key-locked); top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field. A bomb-holding walking enemy mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction; unclear if armored or offset hitbox — treat as dangerous.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring on right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue creature (uncertain).

DARK CHEST ROOM: entered from the start room's right doorway. Two red-lidded unspiked chests at top (~0.33,0.32) and (~0.67,0.32); central spiked chest untouchable and emitting spike projectiles; small black cat-like chasers roaming (~0.33 and ~0.67 at y~0.50); yellow-green blob hazard at left (~0.26,0.48); blue/white pellets appeared near bottom during the fight (source uncertain). Pressing into a red-lidded chest did NOT clearly open it or yield an item. DEATH LESSON: died here repeatedly—chasers plus blob/spike contact drained hearts extremely fast even from full health. Treat as a high-damage death trap; only enter with a clear retreat and fight from range.

KEY: key counter has read 01 in runs. KEYHOLE/GOLD DOOR TESTED AND FAILED REPEATEDLY: with key 01, adjacent to the rock-field left-wall gold door, tried pressing into it, exact vertical alignment, sustained pushes, and pushing-while-firing-left; the door did not open and the key was not consumed. Unresolved; do not spend time or hearts on it. Untested guess: the key may instead open the red-lidded chests or red-lidded barrels.

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing — rocks judged indestructible. Never bomb at low health or adjacent to self.

HAZARDS/HEARTS: green glowing blobs damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and burst over large areas. Damage lands faster than warps can be set up, and hits can occur while standing in a doorway frame. A mid-fight heart refill was seen once; mechanism uncertain (possibly a dropped pickup). At 1 or half a heart any contact ends the run — flee through a hatch rather than fight.

UNRESOLVED: keyhole/gold door opening condition; red-lidded chests/barrels and whether contact or the key opens them; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; meaning of the red laser ring (uncertain); cause of the two-poop center-rock disappearance; whether doorways strictly need diagonal entry or only exact y-alignment.
